result.summary: Found several layout and content issues including cut-off cards, truncated text, and inconsistent element sizing.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with its name truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') and image partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling cards are properly clipped or add a visual indicator (like a partial peek with fade) to show more content is scrollable.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' due to card width constraints.
issues.suggestion: Use text truncation with ellipsis (...) or adjust card width to prevent awkward mid-word cutoffs.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows a partially visible additional category cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or ensure consistent padding so partially visible elements are intentional and not visually broken.

issues.description: The second promotional item in 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the visible screen without clear indication of scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle scroll indicator or ensure the cut-off is clearly part of a scrollable list.

issues.description: Inconsistent heart/favorite icon styling - white heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card differs slightly in visibility from the dark heart icon on the pizza card below it.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background/contrast treatment across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
